::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[Is there a way to produce this division symbol? ÷](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/108035/is-there-a-way-to-produce-this-division-symbol-%c3%b7), asked by [lawlist](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/26911/lawlist) on TeX Stack Exchange (2013-04-10; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)):

> Is there a way to produce this division symbol?  ÷
>
> The term `\div` gives an error of `Missing $ inserted`.
>
> `\÷` is not working either.
:::

Werner's and egreg's comments are correct: you should still use `\div`, but inside of math mode.

So: `$6 \div 3 = 2$`.

![\$6 \div 3 = 2\$][1]
